proposed_fixes.title: Foreground Command Palette after a custom low-level hotkey
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: the custom low-level hotkey is received, but the Command Palette summon path does not reliably foreground/activate its window when another application owns focus.
plan: Reproduce the custom Alt+Space case over a foreground application and distinguish hotkey delivery from ShowWindow/foreground activation.
Correct the activation handoff if the hotkey path is confirmed to summon without foregrounding.
Add a regression that verifies the palette is foreground and keyboard-focused when launched by a custom shortcut.
verification: Alt+Space opens the palette in front of Chrome/Camtasia and accepts typing immediately.
The same configured shortcut does not trigger the foreground application's menu instead.

reproduce.title: Foreground Command Palette after a custom low-level hotkey
prerequisites: Windows 11 x64 with Command Palette enabled and PowerToys Run disabled.
Use the reported custom Alt+Space shortcut, low-level keyboard hook enabled, and foreground Chrome or Camtasia.
setup: Keep fullscreen/busy-state suppression disabled and Command Palette Dock/compact mode disabled, matching the latest report.
steps: With the foreground application active, invoke Command Palette using Alt+Space during ordinary keyboard use.
Check whether the palette appears above the application and receives keyboard focus.
Repeat with the low-level hook setting disabled if the shortcut remains available; record separately whether the shortcut is received and whether the palette is foreground.
reproduce.expected_result: The palette appears above the foreground application and accepts typing immediately; an inconclusive invocation is not counted as reproduction.
